projects.title: Swagat AI
projects.description: LLM-integrated, AI-Receptionist, to assist customers in any offices, and public portals.

projects.title: Biztrack-web-app
projects.description: A real time expense/savings tracker with exportable excel report feature, in your pocket.-mobile phone UI based functional website.

projects.title: BizTrack- Desktop Application
projects.description: Production ready + Deployed Business Ledger application, to store business expenses and generate Excel report.

projects.title: Voice Engine
projects.description: A Technology (Algorithm) that listens to natural language voices of the user, recognizes and communicate accordingly.
projects.live: ready to be used as a tool in any project

projects.title: Receptionist AI
projects.description: A trainable voice receptionist for a front desk. Answers you have trained come first, a local Mistral model (via Ollama) handles the rest, and it takes messages for your team. Ships as a web app and a desktop app.

projects.title: Smart Campus Management System
projects.description: One platform for student services, attendance, gate-pass requests and notifications, connecting a student web portal and admin, faculty and HOD desktop apps through a central REST API.

projects.title: Smart QR Attendance System
projects.description: QR-based attendance for institutes, with a QR generator, a scanner and Excel report generation. Forked from Deepak-Sahoo7 and extended with spoken name-calling, moving toward dynamic QR verification.

projects.title: Livelihood
projects.description: A voice assistant for rural beneficiaries of the PM-AJAY scheme. It speaks in the local dialect and connects people to suitable skill-training programs, replacing paper forms. Built for Smart India Hackathon.

projects.title: Career Recommendation Portal
projects.description: An AI-powered career recommendation and internship matching platform for BPUT students.
